---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea or improvement
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

**What would you like to see?**
A clear description of the feature or improvement.

**Why would this be useful?**
What problem does it solve, or what does it improve?

**How should it work?**
If you have a specific idea — describe the behavior, key binds, UI, etc.

**Anything else?**
Screenshots, examples from other tools, or additional context.
